findings.message: The site answered 403 (anti-bot or login wall): the link is inconclusive, not dead; open it by hand or use a browser check.
Internal link points to a page that is not in the ficha page list.
External link is dead (domain does not resolve).

findings.why: The domain is misspelled ("exmaple"), so the link cannot work, and readers are sent there to check live sailing times.
findings.fix: Replace it with the correct ferry operator or timetable URL, or remove the link and tell readers to check the operator's own site.

findings.why: The internal link slug "porto-weekends-guide" does not match the existing page /blog/porto-weekend-guide, so it leads to a dead page.

findings.quote: | Day-trip ferry return | Baltic Crossing Lines | 07:30 outbound | EUR 54 |
findings.why: The ferry price, departure time and operator have no source in the Sources list, and I cannot verify that Baltic Crossing Lines exists.
findings.fix: Add a link to the operator's fare page, or remove the operator name and give a hedged price range with a source.

findings.why: The post claims prices were checked but cites no source for the ferry price, and no method is described for the others.
findings.fix: Say which sources the prices come from, or soften it to "prices as listed by the operators in September 2026".

findings.quote: consider [the city museum card](https://tallinn-museum-pass.example/card), which bundles entry to many sites
findings.why: I cannot verify that a product called "the city museum card" exists under this name; the better-known Tallinn pass is the Tallinn Card, and the claim about bundled entry is unsourced.
findings.fix: Name the pass exactly and link to the official provider's page.

findings.quote: The Old Town Ice Lantern Walk is planned for 20 February 2027
findings.why: I cannot confirm this event or its organiser. The source is a generic events domain that does not name the organiser, and the date is not independently backed.
findings.fix: Link to the organiser's official announcement and name the organiser.

findings.quote: A winter visit can be magical
findings.why: This is generic filler wording that adds no concrete information.
findings.fix: Replace it with a specific detail, such as typical winter temperatures or what is open.
